subject: Audit coverage gap: request for bridge/attestation to unblock Pioneer Health renewal
messages:
From: Alice Huang <alice.huang@pioneerhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 coverage gap — urgent for renewal

Hi Hannah,

We're finalizing our vendor renewal committee materials and noticed Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report covers 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28. Our procurement/legal requires continuous coverage through our renewal date (2027-04-01). That leaves a coverage gap for 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31.

Can Redwood provide either:
- A bridge letter or interim attestation confirming no material control changes affecting the scope between 2027-03-01 and 2027-03-31, or
- An interim report / statement from your auditor covering that month.

This is blocking our renewal approval and we need a response within 72 hours to avoid the contract being pushed to the next quarter.

Attached: current request form (no PII).

Thanks,
Alice Huang
Head of Vendor Risk
Pioneer Health Systems
[Attachment: vendor_request_form.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alice Huang <alice.huang@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage gap — urgent for renewal

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the interruption. I understand the urgency. I'm escalating internally now to get a bridge/attestation drafted.

Short plan:
- I'll loop in our security & compliance lead and legal to produce a bridge letter/draft within 48 hours.
- If needed, we can provide a short controls affirmation and prior period SOC 2 PDF in the meantime.

I'm attaching the prior period Type II (redacted) for your review; note that our controls and architecture for the core inference runtime have not changed during the queried month.

Would you like a conference call with our security lead today or tomorrow?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_PriorPeriod.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 coverage gap — Pioneer Health (PHS-7832) — urgent escalation

Team — forwarding an urgent request from Pioneer Health (deal PHS-7832). Renewal committee requires no coverage gap. If we can't produce a bridge/attestation within 72 hours they will delay renewal to next quarter (material revenue impact).

What we need from security/compliance:
- Quick decision on approving a bridge letter or interim attestation, with proposed language (I can own customer comms).
- If a bridge letter is OK, can you supply a draft and list of evidence items needed for auditor sign-off?
- Target timeline: draft within 24 hours, final within 48 hours.

Vivek — from a commercial perspective this is high risk. Please advise if we should offer a short-term credit or extended SLA to close.

Thanks,
Hannah

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 coverage gap — Pioneer Health (PHS-7832) — urgent escalation

Thanks Hannah. This is a priority — Pioneer is a strategic customer and renewal is scheduled for 2027-04-01. If we can get a compliant bridge letter quickly, we avoid a protracted procurement cycle.

Dev/Compliance — please prioritize. If legal needs a modeled credit or short-term concession to keep them on the current term, I'm OK to approve up to 5% one-time credit; let's keep that as a last resort.

I'll be available for any direct outreach to the customer's procurement/legal stakeholders.

-Vivek

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 coverage gap — Pioneer Health (PHS-7832) — urgent escalation

Team — here's a rapid path we can follow:
1) Draft a scoped bridge letter certifying that there were no material changes to in-scope controls affecting availability/confidentiality/integrity for 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31. Boilerplate will reference our Type II report and control owners.
2) We need two quick artifacts:
   - Control owner attestation emails confirming no changes (can be short)
   - Change-log extract for infra/config deployments covering Feb 15 — Mar 15 (redacted ok).
3) Legal review required for sign-off; estimate 12 hours if we prioritize.
4) I'll attach a draft bridge letter and the prior report redacted. Please review.

If Pioneer needs auditor-signed confirmation, we can request an interim attestation from our auditor, but that will likely be 7–10 business days and is not compatible with their 72-hour window.

Attachments: bridge_letter_draft.docx, SOC2_TypeII_PriorPeriod.pdf

Next steps: Hannah to confirm timeline with Pioneer and request control-owner emails; Marissa to push legal; Vivek to confirm commercial fallback.

-Dev
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bridge_letter_draft.docx]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alice Huang <alice.huang@pioneerhealth.com>, Tom Reddy <tom.reddy@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage gap — urgent for renewal

Hi Alice / Tom — following our internal reviews, please find attached a draft bridge letter that affirms there were no material control changes affecting the scope of our SOC 2 Type II controls for the period 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31.

Key points:
- This is a scoped bridge letter referencing our audited SOC 2 Type II (covering 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28).
- It is intended to be used by your vendor risk team to satisfy the continuous coverage requirement for the month of March 2027.
- If Pioneer requires an auditor-signed interim attestation, that is feasible but will take ~7–10 business days.

Actions for Pioneer:
1) Please review the attached draft and confirm acceptance or mark edits.
2) If acceptable, we will route the final bridge letter through DocuSign for signature (link below).

DocuSign link (provisional): https://docusign.example.com/rcp/ABC123-bridge-letter
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/PHS-7832

If you prefer a short call to walk legal/procurement through the language, I can schedule with our security lead.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line so we can keep the renewal on the current term.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bridge_letter_draft.docx]
